svg.title: cohors overview, then a dry run
svg.desc:
$ cohors overview
▜▒▟███▙▒▛ cohors ▟██▌█▐██▙ 24 repositories. 6 have work at risk, 15 are clean. ▀▐▖▀█▀▗▌▀ ~/Developer
Do next most urgent first; the command under each step starts it RISK Push 3 commits from 3 repositories They exist only on this machine: analytics-service, design-system and payment-service. Some are more than 2 days old. cohors push --select 'ahead,!diverged' WARN Reconcile 1 diverged branch Local and remote both moved, so neither a push nor a fast-forward pull will work: mobile-app. cohors scan --select diverged …
$ cohors push --select ahead --dry-run
▜▒▟███▙▒▛ cohors ▟██▌█▐██▙ push: git push across the repos you pick ▀▐▖▀█▀▗▌▀ never force-pushes, so remote history stays safe
Dry run would push 4 repos, nothing will change ▸ mobile-app ~/Developer/mobile-app ▸ analytics-service ~/Developer/analytics-service ▸ design-system ~/Developer/design-system ▸ payment-service ~/Developer/payment-service
